_readme: Copy this file to ~/.claude/qa-config.json and fill in your own values. Every skill in the qa-workflow plugin reads it. Secrets never go in here - only the NAMES of environment variables that hold them. Set the actual secrets in ~/.claude/settings.json under 'env'.

jira._note_product_field: Optional. If your Jira project tags work items by product/app with a custom field, set its id and the value you test. Leave null to disable all product filtering.
jira._note_exclusions: Optional. accountIds whose tickets CE-ForTesting should skip (other QA members, bots). Leave empty to consider every unassigned ticket.

prod.label: Production
prod._warning: Set default_env to 'prod' only for read-only production smoke checks. Tokens must have read-only scope.

xray._note: Xray Cloud endpoints are the same for every tenant - no need to change them.

report_portal._note: Optional. Only used by CE-AutomationVSManual. Leave null if you do not run ReportPortal.

automation._note: Optional. Local checkout of your Selenium/Playwright regression repo, and the mapping file CE-AutomationVSManual reads. See references/te-mapping.md for the mapping file format.
